# Phase 8-3 cutover

The quarry shards move to cold storage in phase 8-3; the hot copies stay readable until the cutover
completes. Fixture for the digits-only grounding row in tests/test-injection-gate.sh: its only head
terms a generic prompt could share are the two digits.
